theme: Light & Dark Mode (Monochrome Trust & Premium Swiss)
archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) blended with Premium Luxury

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Syne.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines and Labels MUST be Uppercase, Tiny (text-xs), Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use JetBrains Mono specifically for financial balances, account numbers, and transaction IDs to ensure tabular alignment and a technical feel.
The jump between a heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
STRICTLY NO purple, violet, teal green, or teal blue gradients.
Monochrome primary palette: Color is Function Only. The UI should be predominantly black, white, and greys.
Use Pure Emerald for Credits/Income and Signal Red for Debits/Withdrawals.
Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint greys slightly (e.g., slate/zinc).

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid (Density, Data Correlation, Scanability)
rules: Use Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
Optical Alignment: Adjust padding if icons unbalance the text.
All grid items MUST be direct children.
Admin Panel requires persistent Left-Sidebar navigation with dense, grouped links.
Priority-first KPI row: Top of the dashboard must display the most critical metrics (Available Balance, Total Credits, Total Withdrawals, Pending Withdrawals).
Cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no heavy drop shadows. Use border-collapse style layout for dense data.
Never apply generic soft UI globally.
For financial data clarity, use Flat Solid surfaces instead of Glassmorphism to ensure legibility.

components.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense, professional dashboards
rules: Do not build advanced interactions (datepickers, dialogs) from scratch; strictly use customized Shadcn.
Data tables must be dense but legible, utilizing Shadcn Table components.
Use Recharts for financial analytics charts.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Do NOT use generic placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs below.

hero_or_auth_background.description: Abstract minimal architecture grid for auth screens

card_mockups.description: Premium black credit card mockup for wallet/card features

brand_logo.description: Abstract black and white logo for DigiWallet V2

rules: Hover states must be explicitly set with high contrast.
Minimalist animations: Use micro-interactions for feedback (e.g., slight lift -translate-y-[1px]).
Transitions must specify properties, e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Initialize Tailwind with provided color system and dark mode support (class strategy).
Install and configure @phosphor-icons/react for premium icon representation.
Implement Shadcn UI. Strictly adhere to customized flat cards (no heavy shadows, 1px subtle borders, no 'generic Vercel' look).
Create high-density data tables for the Super Admin panel.
Ensure the application strictly avoids gamification features (no spin wheels, scratch cards, MLM, etc.).
Apply data-testid to every interactive component.
Build the dashboard with the 'Control Room' bento grid pattern.
Implement the persistent left sidebar for the admin panel, keeping navigation easily scannable.
Set up UI toggles for Light / Dark themes using the specified monochrome color rules.
